scene: Fragrant jasmine tea energises you as the barge docks at Grand Transit Pier.
picture: Side-scrolling view of Grand Transit Pier on a flat wooden promenade line. Far left waits an open maglev dragon train. Left of centre stands the broad Pacific Islander man sipping from a teacup, ukulele on his back. Centre hangs a glass cable pod. Far right sits a bullet train beside glowing departure signs.
shown: a sleek maglev dragon train waiting with open doors on the far left
a spherical glass cloud cable pod swaying gently at a centre dock
a gleaming pink-striped bullet train idling at a platform on the far right
